pattern: proxy finish LIGHT (proxy_finish.py stage_light + proxy_finish_light.py): the frozen Pixal3D sheet proxy kept as generated (geometry + texture), made watertight, decimated, baked, optionally reposed with bones

refloor.why: sheet_proxy floored the GROUND-SHADOW FINS (two thin vertical plates under the feet, x -0.37..-0.30 / +0.42..+0.48, y -1.52..+1.52, z 0.00..0.35: the sheet's floor pool extruded; cut below); the feet stand on them. Floor to the -x foot sole (wide foot section from z 0.10 at y 0.4..0.7; the fin's few vertices keep the window's 0.2-percentile at 0.093), then x(7.77 / height) to the sheet front height

cuts.why: ground-shadow fin, FRONT of the toes (stage-1 y < 0.18; both toes start at y 0.20, below z 0.31 only the two fins, x-width 0.03..0.08, live there). Not on the sheet: the side view's floor pool is a cast shadow, not the character
ground-shadow fin, BEHIND the heels (the -x heel ends at y 0.65, the +x at 0.60; the fin tops out at z 0.26 there, the leg starts at z 0.31)
the -x fin's strip under the -x sole (the wide foot section, x-width 0.11..0.17, starts at z 0.00 at y 0.45..0.65; below it only the fin)
the +x fin's strip under the +x sole (the +x foot's wide section starts at z 0.125 at y 0.35..0.5; below it only the 0.03..0.08-wide fin)

dense.why: the head: angular ice mask, eye slits, two horns, the icicle beard and back icicles (proxy sections z 5.11..6.97: x -1.07..1.12, y -0.73..1.30; horn tips at z 7.74); vg_weight 0.3 so the eye boxes below can sit denser
the -x eye slit (teal proxy texels x -0.35..-0.03, z 6.56..6.75, y -0.49; dark rim to x 0.00, z 6.82) held denser so the glow core and the dark rim land on separate faces (vulture_creature lesson)
the +x eye slit (teal x 0.24..0.45, z 6.59..6.76, y -0.45; rim x 0.23..0.48, z to 6.82), as the -x one

light.ao_why: AO baked on the watertight low itself: the proxy's icicle shards are inner shells that black-hole AO rays (crystal_canine / vulture_creature / frost_calf lesson)
light.ao_distance_why: only real crevices darken (the sheet's ice is pale and flat); frost_calf value
light.bake_drop_interior_why: proxy faces with solid on both sides (inner shells under the icicle shards) left out of the bake source so the cage stays tight

recolour3d.name: eye_core
recolour3d.why: spec: 'narrow glowing eye slits (96,210,251)': the proxy's teal slit interiors (median 135,189,193, a* < -8; front ortho x -0.35..-0.03 / 0.24..0.45, z 6.56..6.76) painted the sheet glow chip; the emission comes from glow3d

recolour3d.name: eye_rim
recolour3d.why: the sheet outlines each slit in the seam blue (chip 50,120,183; sheet front px 185..214 / 236..262 x 166..187); the proxy's slit rim is grey-slate (median 95,130,152, L* < 62)

recolour3d.name: horn_light
recolour3d.why: spec 'straight crystalline horns, semi-translucent': sheet front horns median 170,220,241 (cyan, a* -7); proxy horns 132,182,212 (L* 72). Horn boxes = the proxy's two horn columns above the mask dome (z >= 7.25: x -0.39..-0.16 / 0.24..0.47)

recolour3d.name: horn_deep
recolour3d.why: the horns' darker facets to the sheet's mid ice blue (between chips 128,190,238 and the claw blue 107,187,236)

recolour3d.name: ice_body
recolour3d.why: orchestrator: the proxy texture reads GREY-slate / lavender where the sheet is pale icy blue: proxy front-ortho L* p10/25/50/75/90 49/59/72/80/86, a* -2.3 vs the sheet front 49/67/83/89/92, a* -5.5, b* -18. The body ice (L* >= 44, not strongly blue: b* >= -23) to the sheet's icy blue with the proxy's facet shading kept at FULL contrast (gamma 1, so the shaded sides stay mid-blue like the sheet's p25) and the highlights capped (clip 1.05, so the blue channel never saturates: at 1.1 it clipped to 255 and the highlights turned cyan, a* -8.5 vs the sheet -5.5): target 170,212,242 = the sheet front median hue (168,212,240), a few % up for the AO multiply. Runs over the eye boxes too (v1 run 1: a separate eye_skin pass left a lighter square around each slit); the eye core / rim outputs are skipped by its b* >= -23 select

recolour3d.name: ice_shards
recolour3d.why: the proxy's bluer texels (b* < -23: the claws a* -9 b* -26..-29, the beard b* -25 vs the body's b* -16..-19) are the sheet's deeper-blue icicles: to the sheet claw / beard blue (sheet front hands median 107,187,236, beard 115,182,226; chip 128,190,238)

recolour3d.name: seams_deep
recolour3d.why: the proxy's darkest texels (L* < 44: the chevron seams, the V belly line, deep icicle cores; proxy navy-slate median 62,92,127) to the sheet's seam chip 50,120,183 (a touch above it for the AO multiply)

glow3d.name: eye_slits
glow3d.why: glow ONLY in the eye slits (sheet): faces of the slit interiors whose baked albedo is the glow cyan (a* < -12; the recoloured core 96,210,251 has a* -20, the mask a* -4, the rim L* 49) -> region eye_glow (emission 96,210,251 x 1.0)

yaw.why: v2 (artist 2026-10-17: 'our characters should be symmetrical head turns are done through posing'): best mirror plane per height slab of the v1 low (yaw sweep +-10 deg, plane-x sweep, p99): feet z 0..0.5 yaw 0 x 0.07; belly z 2.5..3.5 torso -1..+0.5 deg x 0.05..0.07 (p99 0.069..0.078); chest z 3.5..4.6 -1 deg x 0.03 (0.102); shoulders z 4.6..5.4 +1 deg x 0.05 (0.085); whole low 0 deg x 0.05 (0.126). The BODY is NOT turned, only off-centre by +0.055 u: deg 0 = one rigid shift of -0.055 u in x puts the body plane on x 0 (mirror p99 0.161 -> 0.130). Only the head is turned (beard / mask / horns z > 5.4: +3.75..+4.5 deg; the face's own plane p99 0.050 u, eye slits equal width 0.232 / 0.235 u and equal height z 6.59..6.76 in the face frame, eye-line roll -0.4 deg: turned, NOT sculpted crooked): the repose turns it back with bones. The rig / repose / rigid / focus boxes below are in this shifted frame

rig.spine_why: v2, shifted frame (light.yaw): the spine on the body plane x 0; the head joint (0.02, 0, 5.9) sits on the face's own mirror plane (the neck's half-turn carries it onto x 0) and the head bone points along the face heading, 4.25 deg toward +x of -y (face mirror plane +4.5, whole head +3.75, eye line +3.4 deg), so the repose's heading -y turns the face straight by exactly that

chains.name: arm
chains.why: v2, shifted frame, the proxy's own arm joints per side (surface-sample arm-column centres, 0.08 u slabs): shoulder inside the torso top (z 4.75), elbow (z 3.4: +1.257, 0.429 / -1.251, 0.443), wrist (z 2.3: +1.325, -0.19 / -1.365, -0.11), claw centre (z 1.2: +1.139, -0.227 / -1.157, -0.223); points = +x, points_R = -x as generated (the +x hand ~0.08 u further forward); the repose makes them one mirror pair

chains.name: leg
chains.why: v2, shifted frame, the proxy's own leg joints per side: hip (z 2.45: +0.24 / -0.215), knee (z 1.3: +0.292, 0.555 / -0.285, 0.575), ankle (z 0.4: +0.384, 0.488 / -0.376, 0.57: the -x leg 0.08 u back), toe (y 0.22, 0.06 above each sole: the +x sole floats at z 0.085..0.11, the -x sole is on the floor); points = +x, points_R = -x

clips.why: PLACEHOLDER (movement + height are the open artist questions, OPEN-QUESTIONS frost_giant): idle = breathe + the kit's arm sway; walk = a slow long-legged stride with a small arm swing (the arms reach the knees)

config._doc: LIGHT finish of the raw Pixal3D proxy (seed 56, sha 0a7d8650). Points: stage-1 frame (refloored to the -x sole, x the sheet front height), sheet units. v2 (2026-10-17): symmetry pass only (light.yaw shift + repose); every v1 colour / glow / cut kept. Rig / repose / focus points: the shifted frame (light.yaw).

targets.why: artist 2026-10-17: symmetric rest pose; the two legs mirror-symmetric at the mean (the -x leg ~0.08 u back at the ankle), both soles planted on the floor (v1: the +x sole floated 0.11 u)
targets.radius_why: [reach, taper] per bone: the leg bones never grab the hands (the claw tips hang 0.35 u outside the legs)

targets.why: the two arms mirror-symmetric at the mean (wrist mirror error 0.09 u before). No plant: the hands hang free
targets.radius_why: [reach, taper] per bone: the forearm / hand reach the whole spread claw (0.75 / 0.9 u: at 0.45 / 0.65 the forearm front faces fell to the hips bone, edge stretch 1.42 offline)

targets.heading: -y
targets.why: the head turned 4.25 deg toward +x (see spine_why): the face straight ahead (-y); the neck twists half (-2.125 deg), the head the rest

rigid.why: the whole head moves as ONE rigid body with the head bone: angular ice mask, both eye slits, both horns, the icicle beard and the back icicles (proxy z 5.4..7.78, |x| < 0.85); never deformed or re-sculpted (as generated)

repose.why: v2 (artist 2026-10-17, symmetric rest pose): the proxy's off-centre body is shifted rigidly (light.yaw, deg 0), its turned head and staggered legs / floating +x foot are undone with BONES (proxy_finish_repose), never by mirror-averaging geometry. No tail chain: the sheet draws no tail

proxy_faces_cut.rule: proxy faces whose centroid lies inside a light.cuts volume leave the bake source (normal / AO / albedo) and the proxy-distance metrics

high.rule: marching tets of the whole remesh grid (no mirror)

low.method: collapse decimation: uniform to 300000, then 18000 with the dense boxes calibrated

dense.rule: dense boxes weighted 0.02 (vs 1) in the collapse decimation; the factor bisected until the boxes hold density x the rest's triangles per area

bake.source: the proxy mesh itself (not the remesh)

rows.why: glow ONLY in the eye slits (sheet): faces of the slit interiors whose baked albedo is the glow cyan (a* < -12; the recoloured core 96,210,251 has a* -20, the mask a* -4, the rim L* 49) -> region eye_glow (emission 96,210,251 x 1.0)

glow3d.rule: faces -> glow palette regions (emission -> Glow -> Emission Color); rgb white keeps the baked albedo

mirror_after.rule: every vertex mirrored in X about the plane -> distance to the nearest surface (0 = exactly symmetric)

yaw.why: v2 (artist 2026-10-17: 'our characters should be symmetrical head turns are done through posing'): best mirror plane per height slab of the v1 low (yaw sweep +-10 deg, plane-x sweep, p99): feet z 0..0.5 yaw 0 x 0.07; belly z 2.5..3.5 torso -1..+0.5 deg x 0.05..0.07 (p99 0.069..0.078); chest z 3.5..4.6 -1 deg x 0.03 (0.102); shoulders z 4.6..5.4 +1 deg x 0.05 (0.085); whole low 0 deg x 0.05 (0.126). The BODY is NOT turned, only off-centre by +0.055 u: deg 0 = one rigid shift of -0.055 u in x puts the body plane on x 0 (mirror p99 0.161 -> 0.130). Only the head is turned (beard / mask / horns z > 5.4: +3.75..+4.5 deg; the face's own plane p99 0.050 u, eye slits equal width 0.232 / 0.235 u and equal height z 6.59..6.76 in the face frame, eye-line roll -0.4 deg: turned, NOT sculpted crooked): the repose turns it back with bones. The rig / repose / rigid / focus boxes below are in this shifted frame
yaw.rule: p' = Rz(deg) (p - about) + to on every vertex of the finished low (one rigid turn about Z, the root orientation; no vertex moves relative to another)

mirror_before.rule: every vertex mirrored in X about the plane -> distance to the nearest surface (0 = exactly symmetric)

stretch_all.rule: edge length after / before the repose, edges with a moved vertex

repose.rule: LBS with the contract rig's weights (+ rigid pins), yaw-only straightening (+ lift), applied as rest

stretch_leg.rule: edge length after / before the repose, edges with a moved vertex

stretch_arm.rule: edge length after / before the repose, edges with a moved vertex

stretch_neck_head.rule: edge length after / before the repose, edges with a moved vertex

self_intersections.rule: intersecting triangle pairs sharing no vertex (BVH overlap)

mirror_before.rule: every vertex mirrored in X about the plane -> distance to the nearest surface (0 = exactly symmetric)

mirror_after.rule: every vertex mirrored in X about the plane -> distance to the nearest surface (0 = exactly symmetric)

floor.rule: stage 1 floored the FEET at z 0; the centring puts the lowest point at 0

facing.rule: shell centroid -> the front-most midline point of the shell (proxy finish default)

mirror.rule: every vertex mirrored in X about the plane -> distance to the nearest surface (0 = exactly symmetric)
